note: Platzer et al. (2019) documented de novo MAPK8IP3 variants across 13 unrelated individuals with intellectual disability, confirming its consistent presence.

evidence.text: Platzer et al. (2019) identified de novo variants in MAPK8IP3 across 13 unrelated individuals who all presented with an overlapping phenotype of mild to severe intellectual disability.

source.title: De novo variants in MAPK8IP3 cause intellectual disability with variable brain anomalies
source.quote: Using exome sequencing, we have identified de novo variants in MAPK8IP3 in 13 unrelated individuals presenting with an overlapping phenotype of mild to severe intellectual disability.

numbers.metric: intellectual disability in Platzer et al. cohort

evidence.text: Zhang et al. (2025) note that mutations in MAPK8IP3 cause neurodevelopmental disorders characterized by developmental delay and intellectual disability.

source.title: A toxic gain-of-function variant in MAPK8IP3 provides insights into JIP3 cellular roles
source.quote: Mutations in the gene have been linked to severe neurodevelopmental disorders, resulting in developmental delay, intellectual disability, ataxia, tremor, autism, seizures, and visual impairment.
